$comment: RP1 reel transitions (user 2026-11-11: 'option to choose animations between the transitions of the reel needs to be in the settings. to start with a cross fade animation between transitions. (subtle)'). The join between two pieces of a short, montage, match reel or impact-play reel. Read by services/clip/reel_transition.py and services/studio-ui/user-settings.mjs (Settings > Clips). The user's choice is settings.json clips.reelTransition {kind, ms}. Behind the flag reel-transitions (off by default). More kinds: add a row with an ffmpeg xfade transition name; no code change.
approved: user 2026-11-11 chose the feature and a subtle cross fade to start; the length range and default are the agent's proposal (plan RP1)

kinds.label: Cut
kinds.about: Hard cut with a short audio fade (as before).

kinds.label: Cross fade
kinds.about: The next piece fades in over the last moment of the one before; the sound crossfades. Each join makes the reel this much shorter.
